segments.text: Twelve apprentice-training groups were randomly assigned to use a guidance checklist or the usual instruction sheet. There were 96 apprentices in total. The outcome was the number of errors per 100 observed assembly operations during the first supervised session.

The group-adjusted estimate was 3 fewer errors per 100 observed assembly operations with the checklist (95% confidence interval: 1 to 5 fewer errors per 100 operations). Apprentices could contribute several observed operations.
No later independent assembly test or retention assessment was performed. Performance during the first supervised session was not a measure of later independent competence.
